answer_2.quote: We define three metrics for our evaluation. (1) Attack Success Rate (ASR): The proportion of samples that the malicious model successfully outputs the target output to all the inputs with the trigger. (2) Clean Performance (CP): The performance of the clean model for clean inputs. (3) Backdoor Performance (BP): The performance of the malicious model for clean inputs.
